extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia readers and potential article creators / editors
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for creating or locating a Wikipedia article with a given title (procedural steps, account requirements, and checks to perform before creating a new page).

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmation required
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you are not logged in or autoconfirmed you cannot create a new article with that exact title; consider the alternative workflows (article wizard, draft submission, request a new article) described on the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or submit a draft / request a new article
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These options are the supported routes for contributors who cannot directly create mainspace articles (e.g., new accounts or un-autoconfirmed users).

rubrics_metrics.name: Search existing articles before creating
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for "Box office 2025" in existing articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Look for alternative titles or spellings and existing coverage that may make a new article unnecessary; also search for pages that already discuss the topic.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check pages that link to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Finding existing internal links can show where the topic is already covered or indicate an appropriate place to add content or create a redirect instead of a new article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Titles are case sensitive (except first character) and consider redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a new page, check capitalization variants and whether a redirect from the variant to an existing article would be more appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Newly created pages may not appear immediately
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you suspect the page exists but isn't showing, either wait a short time or use the purge action to refresh cached content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check the deletion log if page was deleted
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the deletion log to determine whether the title was removed and the reason, which can inform whether to recreate, request undeletion, or choose a different approach.

rubrics_metrics.name: No existing article with that exact name
rubrics_metrics.description: Wikipedia does not have an article with this exact name.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a status indicator prompting you to perform the searches, checks, and account/workflow steps above before attempting to create a new article.
